verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent docs cover the buyer and agent-builder side: order intents with tracked spend amounts, delegated signers, and agent checkouts at any merchant. Nothing in the pack shows merchant-facing attribution of orders to an originating agent, or any reporting or filtering of transactions by agent. Order-intent spend accounting is a spending control for the agent's user, not merchant attribution, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a merchant, orders are attributed to the originating agent and I can report on or filter transactions by agent
